name: Carlos Acosta
abstract_title: Evolving Meaningful Sensory Simulations of Reality
abstract: This analysis explores the relationship between consciousness, sensory perception, and the evolutionary processes that shape our understanding of external existence. It utilizes Jung’s (1952) “Acausal Connecting Principle,” to more accurately explain why the different manifestations of phenomenal awareness, closely coordinated in time with specific physical properties of matter, are —in fact, acausal but meaningful sensory simulations of the macro reality we inhabit.
